title: Compare two subshells in a shell
hints: Separate total, radial and angular counts.
solution: $n-1=3$ for both. The $4s$ orbital has three radial and zero angular nodes; $4p$ has two radial and one angular.
statement:
Which statement about hydrogen-like $4s$ and $4p$ orbitals is correct?

[_]{a}

choices: Both have three total nodes; 4p has one angular node and two radial nodes.
explanations: For n=4 total is 3, and p supplies one angular node.
One of its three total nodes is angular.
